_comment: Simplified Chinese texts for the German table fan_burrow. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_CN.

strings.Your Burrow. The walls are bare. Earn so: 你的窝。墙上光秃秃的。去赢点值得挂的东西吧。
